_doc: Frame contract of the mobile course hero (hero_mobile_9x16). Read by the Design framing check (covers-novos/_tools/check_hero_framing.py). apps/web/src/ui/Billboard/hero-frame.test.ts fails when the Billboard CSS tokens stop matching these numbers, so the check can never go stale. All y values are CSS px from the top of the 390 px wide frame.
